topbar.$comment: An application's top bar (1.10, 0110): one row of a start, the screen's title and an end, on the page's own surface with an edge under it and no shadow — a bar that is part of the page, not lifted over it. Its height is the floor of the row and not the row: a control taller than it grows the bar rather than spilling out of it.

fg.$description: Text colour of the top bar.

border.$description: Colour of the edge under the top bar.

height.$description: Minimum height of the top bar.

padding-x.$description: Inline padding inside the top bar.

gap.$description: Gap between the start, the title and the end, and between the controls of each.

title-font-size.$description: Font size of the screen's title.

title-font-weight.$description: Font weight of the screen's title.
